item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded: As a general note, the Ideas Critique forum is for asking reviewers to critique concepts, not just posting partial concepts you don't intend to write up yourself.

item.title: Scp idea give away
item.content:encoded:
Seeking green light: no

Page type: up to you

Genre: mystery

Page layout: up to you

elevator pitch: The SCP Foundation sends one of their investigators to search for something or someone responsible for a series of freak crimes that on the surface don’t seem related.

Central narrative: also up to you but could be told as a tale or a series of logs showing our investigators declining mentality as they go further down the rabbit hole creating paranoia.

Hook: the actual scp is a concept cd from an unknown artist where whenever you play it all the way through, it comes true.

Additional notes: make sure the concept cd relates to the crimes for clarity of cause and effect. Crimes can be related to each other through motifs that are consistent throughout the cd.
